name: The Crystal Castle
source:
Slays Men is finally dead but the horrors of the Wild War are far from over. As the newly crowned Queen of a war torn kingdom the only way to ensure the survival of your people through the harsh winter is to accept an alliance by marriage with Prince Malthe of nearby Therantil. Allowing him, and whatever he brings with him, into...

The Crystal Castle

translation:
杀人者斯莱兹终于死去，但荒野战争的恐怖远未结束。你刚刚加冕为饱受战争蹂躏的王国女王，想让臣民熬过严酷的冬天，唯一的办法就是接受与邻近塞兰蒂尔的马尔特王子联姻结盟。让他，以及他带来的一切，进入……
